properties.name: A revising write says what it removed
properties.rationale: flo2 measured two load-bearing paragraphs lost in thirteen rewrites in one session, caught only by the author re-reading their own call. Promoted 2026-09-20 on Anthony's word and built third in the order he agreed; the notice-only option was chosen and the shrink-refusal rejected.
properties.summary: capture.rs: ShortenedField, the `shortened` list on Revision computed beside `replaced`, the note leading with the loss; one test file; CHANGELOG.
